source.text:
第1行（所选荧光/标记策略 + 透明方法）：**[NeuN + Alexa Fluor 647（胞体）, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647（轴突/树突）, TO-PRO-3（全脑核染）] + iDISCO+（DBE RI匹配）**  
选择理由：iDISCO+ 适用于完整成年小鼠全脑（~10×8×6 mm）快速高透明化与光片成像；有机溶剂脱水/脱脂后透明度高、纤维束走行对比好；TO-PRO-3 与 Alexa Fluor 647 在iDISCO+流程中信号相对稳健，适合全脑三维神经元胞体与神经突起形态图谱构建。

**Protocol Steps：**

english.text:
Line 1 (Selected Fluorescence/Labeling Strategy + Clearing Method): **[NeuN + Alexa Fluor 647 (Soma), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647 (Axons/Dendrites), TO-PRO-3 (Whole-brain nuclear stain)] + iDISCO+ (DBE RI matching)**
Rationale for selection: iDISCO+ is suitable for rapid high-transparency clearing and light-sheet imaging of whole adult mouse brains (~10×8×6 mm); after organic solvent dehydration/delipidation, transparency is high and fiber tract contrast is good; TO-PRO-3 and Alexa Fluor 647 signals are relatively robust in the iDISCO+ workflow, making them suitable for constructing 3D morphological maps of whole-brain neuronal somata and neurites.

**Protocol Steps:**

source.text: 101 预处理与脱水（Dehydration）

english.text: 101 Pre-treatment and Dehydration

source.text: 101.1 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

english.text: 101.1 Soak in 20% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution, gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source.text: 101.2 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

english.text: 101.2 Soak in 40% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution, gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source.text: 101.3 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

english.text: 101.3 Soak in 60% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution, gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source.text: 101.4 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

english.text: 101.4 Soak in 80% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution, gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source.text: 101.5 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇浸泡，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

english.text: 101.5 Soak in 100% (vol/vol) methanol, gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source.text: 101.6 新鲜 100% (vol/vol) 甲醇再次浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

english.text: 101.6 Soak again in fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source.text: 102 脱色/去血红素（Bleaching，可显著降低全脑背景）

english.text: 102 Bleaching/Dehemoglobinization (Bleaching, can significantly reduce whole-brain background)

source.text: 102.1 5% H2O2 in 甲醇（体积比：30% H2O2 : 甲醇 = 1 : 5）避光浸泡。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 hours)

english.text: 102.1 Soak in 5% H2O2 in methanol (Volume ratio: 30% H2O2 : methanol = 1 : 5), protected from light. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 hours)

source.text: 103 复水（Rehydration）

english.text: 103 Rehydration

source.text: 103.1 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

english.text: 103.1 Soak in 80% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source.text: 103.2 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

english.text: 103.2 Soak in 60% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source.text: 103.3 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

english.text: 103.3 Soak in 40% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source.text: 103.4 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

english.text: 103.4 Soak in 20% (vol/vol) methanol/water solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source.text: 103.5 1×PBS 浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

english.text: 103.5 Soak in 1×PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source.text: 104 渗透/封闭（Permeabilization & Blocking）

english.text: 104 Permeabilization & Blocking

source.text: 104.1 渗透液：PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine，轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

english.text: 104.1 Permeabilization solution: PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine, gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

source.text: 104.2 封闭液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清（NDS），轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

english.text: 104.2 Blocking solution: PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum (NDS), gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

source.text: 105 一抗全脑免疫标记（Whole-brain immunolabeling, primary）

english.text: 105 Whole-brain immunolabeling, primary

source.text: 105.1 一抗孵育液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS + 0.01% (w/v) NaN3；加入 NeuN (RBFOX3) 一抗 1:200。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days)

english.text: 105.1 Primary antibody incubation solution: PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS + 0.01% (w/v) NaN3; add NeuN (RBFOX3) primary antibody at 1:200. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days)

source.text: 105.2 同一孵育液中加入 β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) 一抗 1:300（与105.1可同管共孵育）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days)

english.text: 105.2 Add β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) primary antibody at 1:300 to the same incubation solution (can be co-incubated in the same tube as 105.1). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days)

source.text: 106 洗涤（Wash after primary）

english.text: 106 Wash after primary

source.text: 106.1 洗涤液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.01% NaN3，轻摇换液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

english.text: 106.1 Wash solution: PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.01% NaN3, gentle rocking with solution changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

source.text: 106.2 重复 106.1 共 6 次（总洗涤约 36 hours）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours)

english.text: 106.2 Repeat 106.1 for a total of 6 times (total wash approximately 36 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours)

source.text: 107 二抗全脑免疫标记（Secondary, far-red）

english.text: 107 Secondary, far-red

source.text: 107.1 二抗孵育液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 3% NDS + 0.01% NaN3；加入驴抗鼠/兔（按一抗宿主匹配）Alexa Fluor 647 二抗 1:400（分别对应NeuN与TUJ1；若两一抗宿主不同可同管共孵育）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days, Light: protected)

english.text: 107.1 Secondary antibody incubation solution: PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 3% NDS + 0.01% NaN3; add Donkey anti-mouse/rabbit (matched to primary antibody host) Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody at 1:400 (corresponding to NeuN and TUJ1 respectively; if the two primary antibodies have different hosts, they can be co-incubated in the same tube). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days, Light: protected)

source.text: 108 洗涤（Wash after secondary）

english.text: 108 Wash after secondary

source.text: 108.1 PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.01% NaN3 洗涤，轻摇换液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

english.text: 108.1 Wash with PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.01% NaN3, gentle rocking with solution changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

source.text: 108.2 重复 108.1 共 6 次（总洗涤约 36 hours）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours)

english.text: 108.2 Repeat 108.1 for a total of 6 times (total wash approximately 36 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours)

source.text: 109 核染（TO-PRO-3，全脑核定位辅助配准/分区）

english.text: 109 Nuclear stain (TO-PRO-3, whole-brain nuclear localization for registration/segmentation assistance)

source.text: 109.1 TO-PRO-3 1–2 µM（在PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100中），避光轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours)

english.text: 109.1 TO-PRO-3 1–2 µM (in PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100), protected from light, gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours)

source.text: 109.2 PBS 洗涤 3 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours each)

english.text: 109.2 Wash with PBS 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours each)

source.text: 110 再次脱水（Dehydration before clearing）

english.text: 110 Dehydration before clearing

source.text: 110.1 20% 甲醇/水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

english.text: 110.1 20% methanol/water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source.text: 110.2 40% 甲醇/水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

english.text: 110.2 40% methanol/water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source.text: 110.3 60% 甲醇/水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

english.text: 110.3 60% methanol/water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source.text: 110.4 80% 甲醇/水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

english.text: 110.4 80% methanol/water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

source.text: 110.5 100% 甲醇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

english.text: 110.5 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

source.text: 110.6 新鲜 100% 甲醇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

english.text: 111 Delipidation with DCM

source.text: 111.1 66% (vol/vol) 二氯甲烷(DCM)/33% 甲醇混合液浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

english.text: 111.1 Soak in 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM)/33% methanol mixture. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

source.text: 111.2 100% DCM 浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1.5 hours)

english.text: 111.2 Soak in 100% DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1.5 hours)

source.text: 112 RI 匹配（Refractive index matching, DBE）

english.text: 112 Refractive index matching, DBE

source.text: 112.1 100% 二苄醚（DBE, RI≈1.56）预浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, Light: protected)

english.text: 112.1 Pre-soak in 100% Dibenzyl Ether (DBE, RI≈1.56). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, Light: protected)

source.text: 112.2 新鲜 100% DBE 继续浸泡至完全透明（全脑通常需要）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours, Light: protected)

english.text: 112.2 Continue soaking in fresh 100% DBE until fully transparent (usually required for whole brain). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours, Light: protected)

source.text: 113 保存与成像前处理（Storage & pre-imaging）

english.text: 113 Storage & pre-imaging

source.text: 113.1 样本全程浸没于新鲜 100% DBE，避光密封保存（尽量充满容器减少氧化）。(Temperature: RT or 4 ℃, Time: up to 1–2 weeks)

source.text: 113.2 光片成像前更换一次新鲜 DBE 并静置脱气泡/沉降。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1–2 hours)

english.text: 113.2 Before light-sheet imaging, replace with fresh DBE once and let stand to remove bubbles/settle. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1–2 hours)

source.text: 113.3 成像介质与物镜匹配：使用 RI≈1.56 的DBE兼容成像腔与密封材料；样本固定于支架后直接进行全脑光片扫描。(Temperature: RT, Time: per imaging session)

english.text: 113.3 Match imaging medium and objective: use DBE-compatible imaging chamber and sealing materials with RI≈1.56; after fixing sample to a mount, proceed directly to whole-brain light-sheet scanning. (Temperature: RT, Time: per imaging session)
